name: GenEval
intro: GenEval 是面向文本到图像模型的对象组合评测。它用六类模板任务、MS-COCO 对象词表和自动感知模型，逐图验证对象存在、计数、颜色、位置与属性绑定是否满足提示。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, LAION
build_method: 任务模板, MS-COCO对象词表, 自动感知验证, 人工一致性检验
task_type: 文本到图像生成, 组合对齐
eval_feature: 6类组合任务, 目标检测与CLIP验证, 二元逐图判定
scale: 553个提示；每个模型每提示生成4张图
build_method_en: Task Templates, MS-COCO Object Vocabulary, Automated Perceptual Verification, Human Agreement Check
eval_feature_en: Six Compositional Tasks, Detection and CLIP Verification, Binary Per-image Correctness
intro_en: GenEval evaluates object compositionality in text-to-image models. Six templated tasks, an MS-COCO object vocabulary, and automated perceptual models verify whether each image satisfies requested objects, counts, colors, positions, and attribute bindings.
scale_en: 553 prompts; four generated images per prompt for each model
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.11513 and the official GenEval repository. The paper defines six tasks—single object, two objects, counting, colors, position, and color attribute binding—built from task templates and 80 MS-COCO object classes. After per-task random sampling and deduplication, the benchmark contains 553 prompts and generates four images per prompt. COCO Mask2Former checks object presence, count, and centroid-based position; CLIP ViT-L/14 classifies masked object crops for color and binding. An image is correct only when every requested element is correct; scores are averaged over the four images, by task, and then across the six tasks. The paper validates the automatic evaluator with 6,000 human annotations on 1,200 images.
